sources.title: Softr AI Co-Builder
sources.locator: Building a new app; requirements; modifying an existing app; current limitations
sources.finding: Prompts create database structure, pages, access groups and visual blocks. Follow-up chat modifies the current app. The assistant can generate a custom-coded component through Vibe Coding; complex workflows and some system-page edits have documented limits.

sources.title: Softr builder MCP connection
sources.locator: Set up your client; authorization screen; personal access tokens; managing access
sources.finding: External Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other MCP clients can reach a Softr workspace through OAuth or a personal access token with user-selected project permissions. This is an external caller connection, not an embedded Claude Code or Codex coding harness.

sources.title: Softr workspace account
sources.finding: The browser dashboard has a workspace account menu and API Tokens. The documented MCP connection requires Softr account authorization.

sources.title: Softr plan prices and recurring free allowance
sources.locator: Plans at a glance; General comparison; AI credits FAQ; Free plan FAQ
sources.finding: The page explicitly states USD and distinguishes monthly prices from annual equivalents. Free is free forever and includes five AI credits per month. Basic is $25 on monthly billing, versus $19 monthly equivalent paid annually. App-building via the user own MCP AI subscription appears under Pro and above in the current comparison; database/workflow MCP is also listed for lower tiers.

sources.title: Softr platform customer license
sources.finding: The platform is licensed to the customer for the agreement term under a limited non-transferable, non-sublicensable customer grant. Recognizable third-party/open-source components are excluded from that platform grant. This is the main service license, separate from ownership of generated customer products.

sources.title: Softr dated product updates
sources.locator: AI App Builder, November 10 2026; earlier October updates
sources.finding: The dated November 10 announcement describes an AI app builder spanning frontend, database, permissions, workflows and integrations. It is a service update, not a versioned source release.
